name: Chatbot UI
tagline: Open source chat UI for AI models
description: Chatbot UI is an open source chat UI for AI models.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  chatbot-ui:
    environment:
      PGID: $PGID
      PUID: $PUID
      TZ: $TZ
    image: ghcr.io/mckaywrigley/chatbot-ui:main
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    container_name: chatbot-ui
